# Assembly

## Rev A (hand assembly)

- SMD parts sit on **both sides of both boards**, with hand-solder footprints.
  Assemble the SMD parts first and the THT parts last (switches, edge connectors,
  stacking connectors, C105).
- Snap the key board off the logic board along the mouse bites before soldering the
  stacking connectors.
- The edge connectors must sit flush and square to the board edge. Tiles that are not
  aligned stress the neighbouring connectors.

## Rev B (automated assembly, in progress on branch `rev-b`)

Goals, with switch/connector positions, outlines, pinouts and logic parts unchanged:

- all SMD parts of each board on a single side;
- standard (not hand-solder) footprints;
- no THT electrolytic capacitor;
- Kailh MX hot-swap sockets (SMD) on the key board, so the switches are inserted by hand
  after reflow;
- fiducials and a KiKit panel with rails and tooling holes;
- a generic, assembler-neutral output set generated by `kicad-cli`: Gerber X2 + drill,
  IPC-2581/ODB++, a BOM with MPNs, a pick-and-place file, assembly drawings, and fab notes
  (stack-up, impedance, finish).

The THT edge and stacking connectors remain a manual or selective-solder step.
